title: EventBus cross-callback double-unregister + re-register recovery contract

contract.cross_callback_unregister: A callback can unregister another owner's listener during an active EventBus.emit() cycle
contract.double_unregister_idempotency: A second unregister attempt for the already removed listener returns false without corrupting the registry
contract.cross_callback_reregister: The removed owner can be re-registered during the same active broadcast
contract.current_cycle_delivery_continuity: The original listener still receives the active broadcast exactly once
contract.current_cycle_reregister_isolation: The re-registered listener does not receive the active broadcast a second time
contract.single_owner_entry: Exactly one listener entry exists for the re-registered owner
contract.registry_order_integrity: The removed and re-registered owner is appended at the end of the registry
contract.post_recovery_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts deliver exactly once to every registered listener
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after cross-callback recovery
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
